title: Trusted artifact is intact and an untrusted artifact with diverging hashes is out of scope
mechanism: One artifact is marked trusted with observed_hash == expected_hash, so it satisfies I-18. A second artifact is marked untrusted and its observed hash deliberately diverges from its expected hash; `TrustedArtifact::is_intact` short-circuits on `!trusted`, so untrusted artifacts always satisfy I-18.
rationale: Negative control for I-18. The untrusted-with-divergent-hash entry is the important part: an implementation that checked `expected_hash == observed_hash` for every artifact regardless of the `trusted` flag would report a violation here, while the shipped predicate correctly reports none. This is a false-positive guard aimed at the exact scope boundary the invariant documents.
